in_marathi.name: Neelvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neelvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Neelvansh is a Sanskrit name for boys, which translates to 'Blue Lineage'. This name is derived from the combination of two words: 'Neel' meaning 'blue', and 'Vansh' meaning 'lineage'. This name evokes a sense of royalty and connection to nature.
